body: The M4 handoff concern is already closed in the authoritative current worktree. rebuild/api/app.py imports the metrics router and six metrics model tables, includes those tables in fresh-engine create_all, and mounts /api/v1/rebuild/metrics. The real create_app integration suite uses a fresh in-memory database and verifies all six endpoints including workflow-result-stats. Target verification: 6 passed. No production edit was made because duplicating the existing assembly would be a regression risk.
